text:
harper: Heads-up from PM: we need a lightweight 'sunset bridge' doc for the v1 -> v2 change. Requirements: 1) single-page migration guide, 2) three language snippet pairs (py/ts/go), 3) redirect map + automation, 4) PR template with smoke checklist. Target publish: 2025-05-30 AM. Who can own what?
noah: I can take the PR template + add the GH action to run link-checks on docs PRs. I'll add labels: doc-sunset, needs-smoke, redirect-needed.
jia: I'll write the migration page content and the model-equivalence note. Will include an 'is this breaking?' matrix and concrete advice for embeddings reindexing.
omar: Snippets + shim: will prepare side-by-side before/after for the three languages and a tiny shim example for teams who need a stopgap. Will mark shim as unsupported and time-limited.
docs-bot: automation reminder: generate redirects for any /v1/* pages that have a clear /v2/* counterpart; otherwise add a banner to the unmapped pages. We can script generation once model map is final.
harper: Nice. For copy, keep the banner one line: "v1 API retirement scheduled for 2025-06-01. Please follow the migration guide." Jia, can you draft that banner text in the guide?
jia: Yep. Also adding a table row example for embed dims: old-embed-512 -> redwood-embed-1024 (note: reindex recommended; alias fallback available for a 30-day window).
noah: PR checklist (short): - summary + impact - language snippets updated - smoke test link (staging) - list of redirect entries - reviewer assigned
omar: Example shim (py):
```python
# temporary shim - translate v1 call to v2
def invoke_v1_shim(client, model_id, prompt_text):
    return client.responses.create(model=model_id, input=[{"role":"user","content": prompt_text}])
```
I'll include similar minimal shims for TS and Go.
docs-bot: set reminder 2025-05-28 09:00 UTC to validate redirects and banner staging.
harper: Good split: noah = PR templates & automation, jia = migration page & model notes, omar = snippets & shims. Post PR links here when opened and I'll fold into a single playbook PR that wires redirects and banner. If smoke tests fail, ping #eng-oncall.
noah: Will open the template PR today and add the action.
jia: Draft link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2612 (migration page WIP).
omar: Snippet PR coming in the next hour.
docs-bot: tip - run redirect-checker on CI to ensure no /v1/* pages slip through.
harper: Thanks all. Let's keep examples short and obvious (side-by-side). Close loop here once PRs are posted. :white_check_mark:
